target_customer: Online sellers and creators editing product and mobile photos, later general consumers and marketers
problem: Sellers needed professional product visuals from phone photos without design skills. Clipdrop started from AR cut and paste and grew into AI image tools like cleanup and background removal.
business_model: Freemium consumer and prosumer subscription (Clipdrop Pro) plus API

founders.name: Cyril Diagne
prior_employers: ECAL (head of media and interaction design)
Google Arts and Culture (artist in residence)
founders.background_notes: Created Google Art Selfie and the AR Cut Paste prototype published in May 2020

founders.name: Jonathan Blanchet
founders.background_notes: 10+ years web stack, recent focus on machine learning and DevOps

founders.name: Damien Henry
founders.background_notes: Created Google Cardboard with a friend in Paris

technical_complexity.rationale: On-device and cloud computer vision and ML for segmentation and object removal were hard for a five person team in 2020 and 2021.

defensibility.rationale: Image segmentation models and background removal were being commoditized by rivals like remove.bg and Photoroom, so differentiation was speed of product shipping.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Stability AI bought Init ML in March 2023, then sold Clipdrop to Jasper in February 2024. Terms were undisclosed in both deals.

market_need_then: Mobile commerce and creator demand for quick cutouts and cleaned photos, plus a shift to generative image models around 2022 that made the tools much more capable.

branding.brand_signature: Cleanup.pictures, a free viral sibling tool covered by PetaPixel and others
branding.community_and_virality: A community Slack channel and a spinoff site Cleanup.pictures that spread through directories and photography blogs

brand_strength.rationale: Clipdrop and Cleanup.pictures gained broad awareness and press, but ownership changed twice and the brand now sits inside Jasper.

pivots.from: AR object capture and mobile product photos
pivots.to: Broad AI image tools including cleanup, upscaling and text to image
pivots.why: Not stated by sources; aiwiki describes the growth to nine tools by 2023

outcome_analysis: Clipdrop grew from an AR cut and paste prototype into a popular set of AI image tools, raising a small seed in August 2021 and benefiting from the 2022 generative image boom. Stability AI acquired Init ML in March 2023 for an undisclosed price, and Jasper bought Clipdrop from Stability in February 2024 as Stability pulled back from consumer apps, so the founders landed twice inside larger AI companies.
notes: Seed is 1.5 million dollars per the company's own Medium post, about 1.2 million euros per aggregators; totals differ across trackers. Pre-seed date per Seedtable is single aggregator. Competitor list empty: only current comparison pages (Photoroom, Bria, remove.bg) surfaced, none dated to 2021. Pivot date approximate. Name origin not found.
